I replied to Hollis in our DM. The only deadline on record is the one he gave me himself in that DM on 14 Oct: his cutoff for the Marrow Agrisupply paperwork on the Thistle renewal is 20 September.

That date has a problem. Today is 21 October 2026, so 20 September 2026 is already past. I asked him whether he meant 20 September 2027 rather than guessing.

There's no other Marrow Agrisupply deadline in #central-team or in the shared files. The date came from his own DM, so I didn't share it anywhere else.
